scripts.test:production: node --import tsx scripts/src/build-pwa-fixture.ts artifacts/mrg generated-artifacts/production-check verify
scripts.test:visual: pnpm run test:production && node --import tsx scripts/src/test-live-visual.mjs
scripts.test:visual:candidate: pnpm run test:production && node --import tsx scripts/src/test-live-visual.mjs --candidate
scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
